question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

__From__ all her birthday presents, Vanya liked the alphabetical mat the most.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Amongst**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate substitute for the given sentence is '**Amongst**'.
 
• **Among** and **amongst** are prepositions.
 
• **'Among' **means ‘in the middle or included in a larger group of people or things’. **Among** is commonly followed by a plural noun phrase.
 
• **'Amongst'** is sometimes used as an alternative to among. It is more formal and less common.
 
• It indicates a division, choice, or differentiation involving three or more participants.
 
 
• *Example: The results show that both girls are **amongst** the top 10% of students in the whole school.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** ***Amongst** all her birthday presents, Vanya liked the alphabetical mat the most.* 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिए गए वाक्य के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प '**Amongst**' है।
 
• '**Among**' और '**amongst**' में **prepositions** हैं।
 
• '**Among**' का अर्थ है 'बीच में या लोगों या चीजों के बड़े समूह में शामिल'। 'Among' में आमतौर पर plural noun phrase होता है।
 
• '**Amongst**' में कभी-कभी बीच के विकल्प के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है। यह अधिक औपचारिक और कम सामान्य है।
 
• 
 
 
• *Example: The results show that both girls are **amongst** the top 10% of students in the whole school.*
 
 
 
• अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 1** है।
